guide.summary: Makes the water more sour, lowering its pH.
guide.biology: Acidity changes how comfortable water is for living things, and each kind of microbe does best in its own pH range.
guide.rules: Adds acid equivalents that dissolve and diffuse. Shown pH = 7 + (base - acid) / (1 + buffer), kept between 2 and 12. Each tick equal amounts of acid and base cancel out. Most bacteria prefer pH 6 to 8, yeasts and fungi 4.5 to 7, algae 6.5 to 8.5 and Sourbud 4.5 to 6.0; suitability fades to zero over 1.0 pH outside a species' range. Bubble and Sourbud release 0.20 and 0.40 acid for each carbon they eat. No additional modeled reaction.
guide.example: Add a little acidifier to one side of a mixed dish and see which species become stressed first.
